name: Mibu no Tadamine
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 30); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 965.

poems.title: I hate the cold unfriendly moon
poems.author: Mibu no Tadamine
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 30
poems.text:
I hate the cold unfriendly moon,
That shines at early morn;
And nothing seems so sad and grey,
When I am left forlorn,
As day’s returning dawn.

poems.title: 30. 有明の つれなく見えし 別れより (Ariake no tsurenaku mieshi wakare yori)
poems.author: Mibu no Tadamine
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
有明の つれなく見えし 別れより
暁ばかり 憂きものはなし
